name: defender-xdr
description: Ask questions in plain English and get answers from Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting

tenant_id.title: Entra tenant ID
tenant_id.description: GUID of your Microsoft Entra tenant, from the Entra admin center under Overview. Optional here: leave it blank and /defender-xdr:xdr-login will ask for it and save it.

client_id.title: Entra application (client) ID
client_id.description: GUID of an app registration with 'Allow public client flows' enabled, a redirect URI of http://localhost, and admin-consented delegated Microsoft Graph ThreatHunting.Read.All. This is not a secret; client secrets are never used. Optional here: /defender-xdr:xdr-login will ask for it and save it.

graph_base_url.title: Microsoft Graph endpoint
graph_base_url.description: Change only for sovereign clouds: https://graph.microsoft.us (US Gov) or https://microsoftgraph.chinacloudapi.cn (China).

max_rows.title: Maximum rows per query
max_rows.description: Ceiling on the number of rows returned to Claude.

default_timespan.title: Default lookback window
default_timespan.description: Used when a question does not imply a time range, such as 7d or 24h.
